# Sources

All external sources were checked in September 2026 rather than recalled from
memory. Local artifacts are listed with their roles.

## S7 itself

- S7 package site and vignettes — https://rconsortium.github.io/S7/
  - Classes and objects (validators, properties, defaults, computed and
    dynamic properties, custom constructors) —
    https://rconsortium.github.io/S7/articles/classes-objects.html
  - Generics and methods (generic-method compatibility, dots discipline,
    customizing generic bodies, `super()`, multiple dispatch, `class_any`,
    `class_missing`) —
    https://rconsortium.github.io/S7/articles/generics-methods.html
  - `new_property()` reference (getter/setter/validator/default contracts;
    getter output not auto-validated; validator messages exclude the property
    name) — https://rconsortium.github.io/S7/reference/new_property.html
- GitHub repository and README (OOP Working Group provenance: R-Core,
  Bioconductor, tidyverse/Posit, wider community; "functional OOP" framing) —
  https://github.com/RConsortium/S7
- S4 compatibility detail (S4 classes as property types via
  `methods::getClass()`) — https://github.com/RConsortium/S7/issues/587

## Ecosystem packages surveyed

- **ellmer** (R6 `Chat` + S7 `Turn`/`Content`/`Model`/`Provider`; mutability
  rationale in the programming vignette) — https://ellmer.tidyverse.org/ ;
  https://ellmer.tidyverse.org/reference/Chat.html ;
  https://ellmer.tidyverse.org/reference/Turn.html ;
  https://ellmer.tidyverse.org/reference/Model.html
- **ragnar** (`MarkdownDocument` inherits character with normalizing
  constructor; `MarkdownDocumentChunks` inherits tibble with `@document`
  property) — https://ragnar.tidyverse.org/reference/MarkdownDocument.html ;
  https://ragnar.tidyverse.org/reference/markdown_chunk.html
- **stacbuildr** (STAC 1.1.0 as S7 classes; JSON Schema validation;
  `item_from_terra()` / sf / lidR boundary constructors) —
  https://stevenpawley.r-universe.dev/stacbuildr
- **S7schema** (YAML config; AJV via V8; S7 + list inheritance) —
  https://cran.r-project.org/package=S7schema
- **s7contract** (structural interfaces, traits, runtime contract checks,
  generative laws with shrinking and tinytest) —
  https://cran.r-project.org/package=s7contract
- **quickr** (R-to-Fortran compiler; `declare(type())` annotation DSL; S7 in
  Imports; typed S7 IR such as `FortranSubroutine` visible in source) —
  https://github.com/t-kalinowski/quickr ;
  https://rdrr.io/cran/quickr/src/R/quick.R
- **sqlr** (nbenn/sqlr; schema as first-class value between DDL string and
  connection; dialect packages sqlr.postgres / sqlr.sqlite; deliberate absence
  of an "ANSI" fallback dialect; `sqlr_reflect()` round trip as test oracle;
  structural `sqlr_equal()` / `sqlr_diff()`; dependency-ordered rendering with
  cycle-breaking `ALTER TABLE`; `render_sql` multiple dispatch on object and
  dialect) — https://github.com/nbenn/sqlr ;
  https://rdrr.io/github/nbenn/sqlr/src/R/generics.R
- **s7x** (Enum class, scalar and range properties, property unions and
  intersections) — http://s7x.josiah.rs/ ; Enum design rationale:
  https://josiah.rs/posts/enums-in-r/
- **R-ArcGIS stack** (arcgisutils, arcgisviz consuming s7x at scale:
  `s7x::new_enum`, `s7x::property_union`, `class_float`) — public source on
  GitHub, verified via code search.
- **resultr** (Rust-style `Result`/`Option` as an S7 subclass family; abstract
  parent for dispatch; write-once property setters; `wrap_in_result()` generic
  converting conditions to values at one boundary; `and_then()`
  short-circuiting on `Failure`) —
  https://github.com/TransGirlCodes/resultr ; source:
  https://github.com/TransGirlCodes/resultr/blob/main/R/Result.R
- **datarr / reflect** (runtime reflection for base R and S7; descriptor
  objects for properties, methods, callables; `reflect_properties()` walking
  `class@properties` and constructor formals; `method_explain()` dispatch
  traces; `reflect_validate()` with chained classed conditions;
  `reflect_check_project()` conventions-as-checks) —
  https://github.com/SanD94/datarr ; source:
  https://github.com/SanD94/datarr/blob/main/R/s7.R ;
  https://github.com/SanD94/datarr/blob/main/R/check-project.R
- **rtemis** (full S7 rewrite of an ML framework; `PropertySpec`
  constraints-as-data driving validator, default, JSON Schema, and TUI form
  from one declaration; factory-time/load-time declaration validation;
  `setup_*()` eager configuration validation before expensive runs;
  `data_bound` deferred context-dependent checks; container taxonomy;
  `tunable`/`broadcast`/`tune_on_null`/`applies_when` axes; `agent_writable`
  authorship policy kept out of published schemas) —
  https://github.com/rtemis-org/rtemis ; source:
  https://github.com/rtemis-org/rtemis/blob/main/R/010_Props.R
- **tooey** (Model-View-Update / Elm architecture terminal UI framework:
  pure `init`/`update`/`view`, messages and commands as data, runtime-owned
  imperative shell) — https://github.com/devOpifex/tooey
- **rapid** (OpenAPI descriptions parsed into a strict, opinionated S7 class
  as substrate for downstream code generation) —
  https://github.com/api2r/rapid
- **typedjson** (faithful and terse JSON round trip for R values; annotates
  only what JSON cannot express: integer/double, typed NA, non-finite,
  attributes, S3/S4/S7 objects) — https://github.com/nbenn/typedjson
- **objectstore** (embryonic object-store interface in S7; interface-first
  design bet) — https://github.com/Bisaloo/objectstore
- **optimizers7 / parameters7** (statmodels7 family: optimizers as reusable
  S7 objects with composable stopping-rule objects; constrained matrix
  parameters as objects with inverses and derivatives to fourth order;
  deliberate narrowness of layer knowledge) —
  https://github.com/statmodels7/optimizers7 ;
  https://github.com/statmodels7/parameters7
- **structr** (contrast case, not S7: Rust-backed strict JSON schema
  compilation and bidirectional parse/serialize; strict-by-default presence
  via `s_optional()`) — https://github.com/ixpantia/structr
- **provider** (adjacent case: tidyverse-style httr2 healthcare API client
  without an S7 layer; the "before" state of these patterns) —
  https://github.com/andrewallenbruce/provider

## Programming theory

- Alexis King, "Parse, don't validate" (2019) —
  https://lexi-lambda.github.io/blog/2019/11/05/parse-don-t-validate/
- Robert Harper, "Boolean blindness" —
  https://existentialtype.wordpress.com/2011/03/15/boolean-blindness/
- Gary Bernhardt, "Boundaries" (functional core, imperative shell) —
  https://www.destroyallsoftware.com/talks/boundaries
- Yaron Minsky, "Effective ML" (make illegal states unrepresentable) —
  https://blog.janestreet.com/effective-ml-revisited/
- Philip Wadler, "The expression problem" (1998 mailing-list note) —
  https://homepages.inf.ed.ac.uk/wadler/papers/expression/expression.txt
- Bertrand Meyer, *Object-Oriented Software Construction* (design by
  contract: preconditions, postconditions, invariants).
- Eric Evans, *Domain-Driven Design* (aggregates, aggregate roots as
  consistency boundaries).
- Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides, *Design
  Patterns* ("favor object composition over class inheritance").
- Rich Hickey, "The Value of Values" (2012) — talk;
  https://www.infoq.com/presentations/Value-Values/
- Scott Wlaschin, *Domain Modeling Made Functional* (type-driven domain
  design workflow).
- David Parnas, "On the Criteria To Be Used in Decomposing Systems into
  Modules" (1972) — information hiding as design-decision hiding.
- LANGSEC (language-theoretic security) literature on shotgun parsing —
  http://langsec.org/
- David Wheeler's indirection aphorism and its corollary — folklore,
  attributed via Butler Lampson.
- Tony Hoare, "Null References: The Billion Dollar Mistake" (2009 QCon
  talk).

## Craft references (the playbooks document)

- Hadley Wickham, *Advanced R* (2nd ed.), "Translating R code" — the genre
  model for worked DSL campaigns (HTML and LaTeX case studies) —
  https://adv-r.hadley.nz/translation.html ; first-edition DSL chapter —
  http://adv-r.had.co.nz/dsl.html
- Hadley Wickham, *Tidy design principles* — function and argument design as
  patterns and principles in tension (enumerate options, required args
  without defaults, prefer an enum over booleans, extract strategies into
  objects) — https://design.tidyverse.org/
